sections.heading: What is DMine?
paragraphs: DMine (Top Minesweeper) is a cross-platform minesweeper built with the Flutter framework. It retains the core gameplay of classic Minesweeper while featuring a modern UI design and rich functions to bring players a brand-new gaming experience.
Whether you are a hardcore player on Windows or a casual gamer killing time on your phone during commutes, DMine perfectly meets your needs.

sections.heading: Supported Platforms
paragraphs: Cloud data synchronization across all platforms; play on one device, sync progress everywhere.

sections.heading: Core Features
list: Available in 66 languages for global players without language barriers
Your game records are automatically synced to the cloud for others to watch replays
Compete with players worldwide by clearing more levels
Two modes: Beginner and Classic Challenge
No ads, no in-app purchases, pure gaming experience

sections.heading: Game Objective
paragraphs: The goal of Minesweeper is simple: reveal all safe cells without stepping on any mines. Game over if you click a mine; you win once all non-mine cells are revealed!

sections.heading: Basic Controls

rows: Mark uncertain cells with a question mark (?)
Auto-reveal surrounding unmarked cells when flagged mines match the number

sections.tipBox: 💡 Pro Tip: Chord is an efficient skill! When the number of flags around a revealed cell matches its value, left-click the number to auto-reveal all remaining unmarked adjacent cells.

sections.heading: What Do Numbers Mean
paragraphs: When you reveal a cell, a number from 1 to 8 appears, indicating how many mines are hidden in the 8 surrounding cells.
Example of a 3×3 grid: A middle number 1 means exactly 1 mine in its 8 adjacent cells.
list: And so on, up to a maximum of 8
sections.tipBox: 💡 Blank cells (no number) mean no mines nearby. The game automatically reveals connected blank areas — this is the chain expansion mechanic in Minesweeper.

sections.heading: Game Modes
paragraphs: Fixed Board: 16 × 30 (480 cells)

rows: Mines increase per run with no upper limit

sections.extraParagraph: Classic Challenge Rule: +6 mines for the first 4 clears, then +3 mines every 3 levels, next +2 mines every 3 levels, finally +1 mine per level indefinitely.

sections.heading: Win & Lose Conditions
list: Reveal all non-mine cells or correctly flag all mines
Game ends immediately when clicking a mine
sections.tipBox: 💡 Your first click is always safe! DMine guarantees the first tap will never land on a mine.

sections.heading: Replay & Share
paragraphs: Your cleared game records are automatically uploaded to the cloud. Other players can watch your full replay in the replay section. Replays are view-only and cannot be edited.

sections.heading: Leaderboard
paragraphs: DMine features a global cloud leaderboard ranked by cleared levels. Higher levels mean better rankings; compete with Minesweeper players worldwide.

items.title: 1-2-1 Pattern
paragraphs: This is the most common and essential pattern in Minesweeper. When you see a straight 1-2-1 number sequence:
list: The cell above the middle 2 is always safe
items.tipBox: 💡 This is a deterministic pattern — no guessing required, 100% logical deduction.

items.title: 1-2-2-1 Pattern
paragraphs: The 1-2-2-1 sequence is another classic fixed pattern:
list: One mine above the gap between the two 2s
Safe cells above the two side 1s

items.title: Edge Pattern
paragraphs: Numbers against the board edge make deduction easier, as one side of surrounding cells is eliminated from calculation.

items.title: Chord Technique
paragraphs: The most critical skill to speed up your game. When flagged mines around a number match its value, middle-click or press left+right mouse together to auto-reveal all unmarked adjacent cells.
Example: If a 3 already has 3 surrounding flags, chord the 3 to automatically reveal the remaining 5 cells.
items.tipBox: ⚡ Pro Secret: Almost all veteran players use chord constantly — flag mines and chord instantly to multiply your speed.

items.title: Subtraction Deduction
paragraphs: When some mines around a number are already flagged, subtract them to get the remaining hidden mines. For example: a 3 with 1 existing flag still has 2 hidden mines nearby.

items.title: Combined Multi-Number Deduction
paragraphs: Do not analyze numbers alone. Combine adjacent digits to reason logically. Neighboring numbers share surrounding cells; use intersection and complement relationships to unlock more clues.

items.title: Probability Analysis
paragraphs: When faced with unsolvable guess situations, choose cells with the lowest mine probability:
list: Prioritize cells close to revealed areas
Calculate the ratio of remaining mines to blank cells in complex scenarios
items.warnBox: ⚠️ Guessing cannot be completely avoided in Minesweeper, but probability analysis can raise your win rate above 90%.

items.title: Pattern Recognition
paragraphs: Pro players do not count cells one by one; they recognize whole number patterns instantly. With practice, you will instantly identify mine positions and safe zones from familiar number combinations.

items.title: Mouse Operation Mastery
list: Right hand for revealing, left hand for flagging with clear division
Use chord instead of repeated clicks to reduce movement distance
Keep a consistent pace instead of fluctuating speed

items.title: Opening Strategy
paragraphs: DMine ensures your first click is safe. Start by revealing large blank zones to create more clues for later deduction.

items.title: Priority Rules
paragraphs: Handle the board in this order:
orderedList: Solve all deterministic patterns first (1-2-1, 1-2-2-1, etc.)
Process edge numbers one by one

items.title: Guessing Strategy
paragraphs: When you have to guess:
list: Track unmarked mines to assist judgment
Solve other areas first to simplify the board
React instantly to classic number combinations and build muscle memory
Analyze mistakes and optimize your logic
Watch top players' replays, set goals and challenge yourself
Complete levels without placing any mine flags
items.tipBox: 🎯 Level Reference: Casual Players under Level 10, Skilled Players under Level 20, Pros over Level 30, Top Experts can reach Level 30+ with flagless play.
